entries.subject: DAMIT 5942: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-5942.txt. Model 5942, version 2022-02-14, pole (237°, 1°), period 16.2133 h match the retained metadata. The archive supplies no diameter for this model; a separate scale constraint is required. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: AKARI AcuA
entries.finding: [AKARI AcuA](https://data.darts.isas.jaxa.jp/pub/akari/AKARI-IRC_Catalogue_AllSky_AcuA_1.0/) — included as an explicitly approximate thermal size transfer. Its fitted nonrotating-sphere diameter is 153.42 ± 2.38 km. Formal catalog error omits additional shape, spin and thermal-model effects; no total confidence interval is invented. The original catalogue row for asteroid 106 was retrieved again and matched field-for-field with the retained row, including diameter, reported error and detection count.

entries.subject: Shape and spin alternatives
entries.finding: Alternative archive solutions: model 5943, pole ['57', '12'], [Model 5943](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/asteroid_models/view/5943) The live DAMIT export lists these other models for this target: 5943: pole (57°, 12°), 16.2126 h, version 2022-02-14. These are archive alternatives, not necessarily newly released models or preferred replacements. Comparing their source methods and any pole-specific calibration remains necessary before changing the selected mesh.
entries.revisitWhen: A released numerical replacement or independent pole/size constraints that distinguish the recorded alternatives, followed by comparison against the currently selected model.

entries.subject: Dione whole-disc color
entries.finding: Gaia Collaboration, Galluccio et al. (2023) published the mean of 21 Gaia epoch spectra of the unresolved disc: reflectance against the Sun in 16 bands from 374 to 1034 nm, 1 at 550 nm (0.925 at 462 nm, 0.941 at 638 nm). The shape is painted in that one color (#3a3b38 in sRGB) through the shared disc-integrated-color method, scaled to the 4.4% geometric albedo JPL lists (± 0.8%), from NEOWISE (Masiero et al. 2012, ApJ 759, L8; PDS bundle neowise_diameters_albedos 2.0). It is one mean, not a map. Tinaut-Ruano et al. (2023), A&A 669, L14, found Gaia DR3 reflectances slightly too red at wavelengths shorter than 550 nm; the bands are used as published, without that paper's correction.
